scope: Bundled native editing UI with independent FamiTone2 fixture; byte edits, isolated history, source races, Save As states and input ownership. No browser layout, listening or canonical Audio conversion claim.

results.name: Native controls mount once inside general analysis with labels and native keyboard fields
Explicit analysis identifies native songs, instruments and partial SFX without project changes
Unknown, invalid and oversized ROMs show profile status and never enable editing
Native note edit changes only a copied command byte and exports both ROM and evidence
Native Undo and Redo re-decode target bytes without using project history
No-op, invalid, noise and DPCM selections preserve the current native copy
A new inspected source refuses native edit, history and exports from the old session
Delayed native analysis cannot publish a result for a changed source
Delayed native patch rejects intervening selection edits and preserves prior copy
Delayed history restore cannot replace a copy after the inspected source changes
Actual pending Save As returns busy honestly and leaves the session available
Native fields block emulator keyboard, touch and controller input while retaining text defaults
Native history is bounded and a new edit after Undo discards only its redo branch
